name: Teen Performance Ensemble (Prince George's County Parks and Recreation)
org: Prince George's County Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
city: College Park, MD (auditions); Prince George's County, MD
what_you_do: Join a six week summer touring production of an original play. It performs for M-NCPPC summer camps. There is a public show at the end. You rehearse weekly starting in spring 2027.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 16 to 18 who pass the audition.
pay_detail: Paid, part time. The pay rate is not stated on the page.
duration: Weekly rehearsals starting March or April 2027 (county pages differ) and a summer performance schedule from June 28 to August 6, 2027.
deadline_text: County pages disagree on the audition date. One says Sunday, February 7, 2027 at 3 p.m. The other says Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 3 p.m. Both say the Clarice in College Park (8270 Alumni Dr). Email to confirm.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the audition event page and go to the audition. It is free. Email arts@pgparks.com or megan.merchant@pgparks.com to confirm the date and ask what to prepare.
notes: Maryland Department of Labor says work permits are required for all minors under 18 to work in Maryland. A permit is issued only after the minor is offered a job. Confirm first. Neither page says what to prepare.
